public sealed class ModInfo

## Properties

### Authors {#authors}

public IReadOnlyList<string> Authors { get; }

The mod's authors, as listed in its manifest; empty if none are listed.

### DataDirectory {#datadirectory}

```csharp
public string DataDirectory { get; }
```

The absolute path of a folder for files the mod writes at runtime, such as caches and saved data: `Lustral/data/<id>/`. The folder is preserved when the mod is updated and is created on first access. Settings belong in [`Mod.Config`](/api/mod#config).

### Description {#description}

```csharp
public string? Description { get; }
```

The mod's description, or null if its manifest has none.

### Directory {#directory}

```csharp
public string Directory { get; }
```

The absolute path of the mod's folder, `Mods/<id>/`, which contains its assemblies and the files it ships. The folder is replaced when the mod is updated; files written at runtime belong in [`DataDirectory`](/api/mod-info#datadirectory).

### Id {#id}

```csharp
public string Id { get; }
```

The mod's ID, for example `sxxr0.betterhud`.

### Name {#name}

The mod's display name.

### Version {#version}

public string Version { get; }

The mod's version, for example `1.2.0`.
